title: IT Management Intern - April 2026
full_description:
Makati City, Philippines
City of Taguig, Philippines
Qualifications:•Currently pursuing a degree in BS IT or IT Engineering / Computer Science program•Willing to report on-site 2 days a week, 8 hours per day (2 days minimum)•Willing to be cross-deployed in One Ayala East Tower (Makati) or World Plaza (BGC) office when necessary•Basic understanding of hardware, software and network fundamentals•Basic understanding in laptop hardware troubleshooting•Proficient in Microsoft Office - Word, Excel, Powerpoint•Good communication skills in English and Filipino language•Basic understanding in formatting laptop units using Windows and Mac OS a plus•Willing to learn and adapt to a fast-paced IT environment
